description_en: Creates a health check template in a specified region
description_zh: 在指定地域创建健康检查模板
name: CreateHealthCheckTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value on your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。


若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the health check template. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter, Chinese character, or digit, and can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查模板名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以字母、中文或数字开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: health_check_template_name

parameters.help_en:
The port used for health checks.

Valid values: 0 to 65535.

Default value: 0, which indicates that the port of the backend server is used for health checks
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查使用的端口。

取值范围：0~65535。

默认值：0，表示使用后端服务器的端口进行健康检查
parameters.name: health_check_connect_port

parameters.help_en:
The domain name used for health checks. Valid values: 

$SERVER_IP: the private IP of the backend server. If an IP address is specified or this parameter is not specified, load balancing uses the private IP of the backend server as the domain name for health checks.

domain: The domain name must be 1 to 80 characters in length, and can contain only letters, digits, periods (.), and hyphens (-).

This parameter takes effect only when `HealthCheckProtocol` is set to HTTP or HTTPS
parameters.help_zh:
用于健康检查的域名。取值： 

$SERVER_IP：后端服务器的私网IP。当指定了IP或该参数未指定时，负载均衡会使用后端服务器的私网IP当做健康检查使用的域名。

domain：域名长度为1~80字符，只能包含字母、数字、半角句号（.）和短划线（-）。

只有`HealthCheckProtocol`设置为HTTP或HTTPS时该参数生效
parameters.name: health_check_host

parameters.help_en: The list of normal status codes for health checks
parameters.help_zh: 健康检查正常的状态码列表
parameters.name: health_check_codes

parameters.help_en:
The interval between health checks.

Valid values: 1 to 50. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 2
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查的时间间隔。

取值范围：1~50秒。

默认值：2秒
parameters.name: health_check_interval

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for receiving a response from a health check. If the backend server does not respond within the specified timeout period, the health check fails.

Valid values: 1 to 300. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh:
接收来自运行状况检查的响应需要等待的时间。如果后端服务器在指定的时间内没有正确响应，则判定为健康检查失败。

取值范围：1~300秒。

默认值：5秒
parameters.name: health_check_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The URL used for health checks.

The URL must be 1 to 80 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), percent signs (%), question marks (?), number signs (#), ampersands (&), and the following extended characters: `_;~!()*[]@$^:',+`. The URL must start with a forward slash (/).

This parameter is available only when `HealthCheckProtocol` is set to HTTP or HTTPS
parameters.help_zh:
用于健康检查的URL。

长度限制为1~80，支持使用字母、数字和短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、百分号（%）、半角问号（?）、井号（#）和and（&）以及扩展字符集`_;~!（)*[]@$^:',+`。URL必须以正斜线（/）开头。

只有`HealthCheckProtocol`为HTTP或HTTPS时才有该参数
parameters.name: health_check_path

parameters.help_en:
The health check method. Valid values:

HEAD (default): the default method for HTTP and HTTPS listener health checks.

POST: the default method for gRPC listener health checks.

GET: If the length of the response message exceeds 8 KB, the message is truncated. However, this does not affect the health check result.

This parameter is available only when HealthCheckProtocol is set to HTTP, HTTPS, or gRPC
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查方法。取值：

HEAD（默认值）：HTTP和HTTPS监听健康检查默认采用HEAD方法。

POST：gRPC监听健康检查默认采用POST方法。

GET：如果响应报文长度超过8KB，会被截断，但不会影响健康检查结果的判定。

只有HealthCheckProtocol为HTTP或HTTPS或gRPC时才有该参数
parameters.name: health_check_method

parameters.help_en:
The protocol used for health checks. Valid values:

HTTP (default): sends HEAD or GET requests for browser access impersonation to check whether the server application is healthy.

HTTPS: sends HEAD or GET requests for browser access impersonation to check whether the server application is healthy. (Provides data encryption, making it more secure than HTTP.)

TCP: sends SYN handshake messages to check whether the server port is alive.

gRPC: sends POST or GET requests to check whether the server application is healthy
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查采用的协议。取值：

HTTP（默认值）：通过发送HEAD或GET请求模拟浏览器的访问行为来检查服务器应用是否健康。

HTTPS：通过发送HEAD或GET请求模拟浏览器的访问行为来检查服务器应用是否健康。（数据加密，相比HTTP更安全。）

TCP：通过发送SYN握手报文来检测服务器端口是否存活。

gRPC：通过发送POST或GET请求来检查服务器应用是否健康
parameters.name: health_check_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The HTTP version for health checks.

Valid values: HTTP 1.0 and HTTP 1.1.

Default value: HTTP 1.1.

This parameter is available only when `HealthCheckProtocol` is set to HTTP or HTTPS
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查HTTP协议版本。

取值：HTTP 1.0或HTTP 1.1。

默认值：HTTP 1.1。

只有`HealthCheckProtocol`为HTTP或HTTPS时才有该参数
parameters.name: health_check_http_version

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive successful health checks that must occur before the health check status of a backend server changes from Failed to Successful.

Valid values: 2 to 10.

Default value: 3
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查连续成功多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由失败判定为成功。

取值范围：2~10。

默认值：3
parameters.name: healthy_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive failed health checks that must occur before the health check status of a backend server changes from Successful to Failed.

Valid values: 2 to 10.

Default value: 3
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查连续失败多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由成功判定为失败。

取值范围：2~10。

默认值：3
parameters.name: unhealthy_threshold

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:

true: sends a precheck request without creating the resource. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the request fails the precheck, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the precheck, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): sends a normal request. After the request passes the precheck, the http_2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会创建资源。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回http_2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

fields.help_en: The tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 128 characters in length, and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

HealthCheckTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the health check template
